name: Avatar
description: A person's or item's picture, initials or a generic user icon, in a circle or square.
overview: Images, letters in each colour, icons, sizes, status, badges and a group, in light and dark. The photos are AI-generated placeholders of fictional people: drop a real photo on the Avatar layer's fill.

when: People and owners in tables, cards and the header; square for items such as apps or sources.
A photo when there is one; initials, then the user icon, as fallbacks.
dont: Leave it without alt (the person's name).
Use colour alone to mean something: colours tell people apart, they are not statuses.
